notes.title: The Christmas Gifts release date has been confirmed!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

I am really proud to announce that The Christmas Gifts game will be released on 5th October, 2018 and it has been confirmed. 

I am currently preparing the final build for the release and I hope it will soon be ready for release. I hope you will enjoy the game. Thanks to your patience!

If you have any queries please feel free to let me know.

Best Regards,
Anamik
